context: A teacher walks a uni student through a sociology field-study paper
purpose: Teach: 自力/自我/様相/取り巻く/牧場/農場/方位/論者

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: レポート読みましたよ。フィールド調査の対象に牧場を選んだのは面白い視点ですね。
lines.en: I read your paper. Choosing a ranch as your field-study subject is an interesting angle.
lines.style: Warm professorial tone, encouraging but with subtle critical undertone here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。実は隣町の農場とも比較したくて、両方訪問したんです。
lines.en: Thank you. Actually I wanted to compare it with a farm in the next town, so I visited both.
lines.style: Eager student voice, slightly nervous, hoping for approval here.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。ただ、地域社会を取り巻く経済構造の分析がまだ浅い印象です。
lines.en: I see. However, the analysis of the economic structures surrounding the local community still feels shallow.
lines.style: Direct academic critique, measured pace, lifting one eyebrow slightly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そこは自分でも気になっていて、自力で資料を集めたんですが、限界がありました。
lines.en: I was worried about that part myself, and I gathered materials on my own, but I hit limits.
lines.style: Honest self-aware admission, slightly deflated, looking down briefly here.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それなら都市社会学の論者を何人か引用してみてください。様相がぐっと立体的になります。
lines.en: In that case, try citing several urban-sociology theorists. The picture will become much more three-dimensional.
lines.style: Constructive guidance, leaning forward slightly with genuine enthusiasm now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。あと、若い農家の自我の確立を扱った章はどうでしたか?
lines.en: Understood. Also, how was the chapter dealing with young farmers establishing their sense of self?
lines.style: Shifting topic carefully, fishing for feedback on favorite section here.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そこは光っていました。ただ、論文の方向性を決める方位磁針として、もう少しインタビュー引用を増やすと良いですね。
lines.en: That part shone. Though as a compass guiding the paper's direction, increasing interview quotes a bit more would be good.
lines.style: Genuine praise followed by practical methodological pointer with metaphor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど、来週までに修正してまた持ってきます。
lines.en: I see, I'll revise it by next week and bring it again.
lines.style: Reinvigorated commitment, standing up slightly, clutching notebook tightly here.
